claims.text: Over the 14 days from the patch, the positive share was +1.2 points against the interrupted time series estimate of what it would have been without the patch (90% range -12.1 to +14.4). That isn't enough to credit the patch: its 90% range includes no change at all.
Negative reviews mentioning performance changed by -8.95 percentage points in the window compared to the baseline.
Positive sentiment share in the window averaged 67.67 percent across 2168 reviews.
Discounts were unknown during the review window.
Off-topic negative review share changed by 0.07 percentage points.
The total sentiment change was -3.77 percentage points.
The within-group sentiment change component was -4.46 percentage points.
The change in sentiment was established across the review window.

report.summary: Positive sentiment share averaged 67.67 percent across 2168 reviews during the review window, while the total sentiment change was a fall of 3.77 percentage points. Negative reviews mentioning performance changed by a fall of 8.95 percentage points compared to the baseline. Over the 14 days from the patch, the positive share was a rise of 1.2 points against the interrupted time series estimate. Discounts were unknown during the review window, and off-topic negative review share changed by 0.07 percentage points. The within-group sentiment change component was a fall of 4.46 percentage points, and the change in sentiment was established across the review window. Explanation H3 and explanation H5 are ruled out. Explanation H1, explanation H2 and explanation H4 are inconclusive.
